subject: Request: Senior approval for atypical Hosted API rate concession
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@healthlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HealthLytics: ask for 25% hosted API concession (details + SOW)

Mina / Karthik — quick one. HealthLytics (Alex) asked for a 25% concession off our standard Hosted API usage rate for the first 12 months to match a competing offer they received. They are proposing to commit $120k/month run-rate for 12 months (start-of-contract).

Attached: HealthLytics_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with proposed volumes). Also attaching a quick pricing model; model assumes standard rates before discount.

Why this matters: HealthLytics is strategic in behavioral health vertical, strong references, likely to expand into embeddings and private deployment in 2027. If we push back hard they escalate to procurement and legal immediately.

Request: This is over standard deal-desk threshold (we cap at 20% without senior ok). Can you advise if we can take a non-standard 25% for the first 12 months and what approvals required? Need answer by EOD Monday (12/14) for a scheduled procurement call.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthLytics: ask for 25% hosted API concession (details + SOW)

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the SOW and the attached model. Two quick clarifying asks before I take this up the chain:

- Can we confirm committed term? Customer text says 12 months but procurement hinted at 24-month minimum if we want deeper concessions.
- Do they need the concession applied across all usage tiers, or only to generation tokens? (SOW ambiguous)
- Any legal carve-outs they insist on (data residency / audit rights)?

Suggested approach: escalate to senior for an exception with a structured concession: 25% off Hosted API usage for the first 12 months conditional on a 24-month committed minimum and an annual true-up clause. Recommend Finance sign-off on revenue recognition impact; Legal sign-off on modified SLA/liability language.

I'm looping in Marissa and Rishi for exec/finance review — Marissa, can you weigh in on whether the strategic fit justifies 25%? Rishi — can you do a quick P&L glide path if we accept 25% for 12 months vs 20%? I need an answer by COB Monday.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@healthlytics.com>, HealthLytics Legal <legal@healthlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: HealthLytics: ask for 25% hosted API concession (details + SOW)

On Thu, Dec 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — I reviewed the SOW and the attached model. Two quick clarifying asks before I take this up the chain:

Folks — I reviewed the context and the customer history. HealthLytics is a strategic reference opportunity in the behavioral-health vertical and accelerating. I will approve an exception at 25% under the following conditions:

1) 24-month committed term (minimum spend guarantee written into SOW);
2) Discount applies to Hosted API usage charges only (not to professional services or one-time integration fees);
3) 12 months at 25% (promotion period), reverting to 15% for months 13–24;
4) Customer must accept our standard SLA and data residency clause; any deviations must be documented and separately approved by Legal;
5) We require a right-to-audit clause and a quarterly usage true-up; any overages billed at the post-discount rate.

Rishi — please confirm the revenue impact and proposed credit treatment (we prefer amortized concession vs. upfront credits). Legal (copied) — please review revised SOW (Ben / Mina, attach the SOW with the above language).

Ben/Alex — if HealthLytics accepts the above structure, we will prepare a redline SOW and expedited countersign path. Mina, please record as an exec-sanctioned concession in the deal record.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, HealthLytics Legal <legal@healthlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API concession (conditional) — next steps

Alex — following our internal review, we have senior approval to proceed with a 25% concession on Hosted API usage for HealthLytics under these final conditions (summary):

- 24-month committed term with minimum annual spend guarantee (details to be included in SOW)
- Discount: 25% off Hosted API usage for the first 12 months; then 15% months 13–24
- Discount applies to usage charges only; PS and one-time fees excluded
- Quarterly usage true-up; overages billed at post-discount rates
- Standard Redwood SLA and data residency language must remain; any deviations require legal approval

Attached: updated SOW draft (HealthLytics_SOW_v3.pdf) and pricing model for the concession (pricing-model.xlsx). Please review and confirm acceptance so we can circulate the redline for countersignature. If accepted, procurement can expect an expedited path with Legal standing by.

Action items:
- Alex / HealthLytics: confirm acceptance of the above structure by EOD Wednesday (12/16)
- Ben: prepare redline of the SOW and circulate to Legal (cc Mina)
- Rishi: we will follow the amortized concession approach unless you advise otherwise

Thanks all — Mina
Mina Haddad
